Used locally to render the Bilibili sign-in QR code; no remote image service.

The upstream npm package declares MIT in package.json and its source header,
but omits a standalone license file. This directory preserves that notice and
the MIT permission text. The source header also states:
The word 'QR Code' is registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
